sections.h2: Retreat at Edinburgh Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 60 residential sales closed in Retreat at Edinburgh (Chesapeake, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $557,740, above the citywide median of $420,000, and homes took a median of 61 days to sell, slower than the citywide median of 18 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Retreat at Edinburgh sales closed between $529,490 and $574,992, or about $227 per square foot against $219 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($571,990, 33 sales) was about 7% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($535,990, 27 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Retreat at Edinburgh sales were in ZIP code 23323.

sections.h2: What Stands Out About Retreat at Edinburgh
sections.html: 100% of the homes sold here were built in 2015 or later; across Chesapeake the figure is 24%. 0% of sales here were detached homes, versus 76% citywide. The median Retreat at Edinburgh home is about 2,557 square feet, larger than the 1,970 square foot citywide median.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Retreat at Edinburgh
sections.html:
All of the sales were attached homes such as townhomes or condos. The median home was about 2,557 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 2,314 to 2,614 square feet. 43% of the homes that sold had 4 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 2024 and 2026, with a median year built of 2025, so this is mostly newer construction.
